A crafted rationale such as an inline image reference to an attacker URL passes all rules unchanged - no pipe, no leading block character, no comment delimiter - and GitHub renders it as a live <img> in the public PR body, firing an outbound request that leaks the viewing reviewer IP and user-agent and confirms when the PR was read. Passive tracking-pixel exfiltration. The gap applies to every free-text value the encoder touches, and to the sibling pr-body-advisories.spec.md, which delegates all escaping to this same encoder.

RECOMMENDATION: Neutralize markdown link/image construction at the same interpolation boundary - escape [ and ], and any ! immediately preceding [, or break the ]( sequence. CWE-116.

CONSTRAINT ON THE FIX: do NOT append this as "a fifth rule". The contract already has five rules and rule 5 is Diagnostics. Insert it BEFORE table-cell safety and renumber, coordinating with structural-architect:incomplete-task-map:6231f1c4 (SA-2), which fixes the Task Map rule count.

```
SEC-2 (blocker, rate-limiting / availability) — Input Contracts / Routing entries "Degradation", and Error Cases readRoutingSidecar() row.

FINDING: readRoutingSidecar() can throw INVALID_ROUTING_ENTRY, not only the codes the spec enumerates. parseSidecarJson calls validateEntry on every entry at READ time (lib/plan-routing-sidecar.mjs:228), so rationale.length > MAX_RATIONALE_LEN (400), a non-string rationale, a missing scores dimension, or an out-of-range score each throw INVALID_ROUTING_ENTRY. The spec enumerates only INVALID_PLAN_PATH, INVALID_SIDECAR_JSON, and "a read error". An implementer following the literal enumeration writes a code-by-code catch and the throw escapes, contradicting the Behavioral Contract ("never blocks... degrade to explicit gaps... rather than to a non-zero exit") and the postcondition "Exit code is 0 whenever HEAD and the base ref resolve." Because rationale is attacker-influenceable and the cap is enforced on read, a committed sidecar with an oversized entry crashes the generator in CI.

RECOMMENDATION: Widen the degradation clause to "any throw from readRoutingSidecar()" - a catch-all at the call site, not a code-by-code switch - and state that the annotation renders whatever err.code was thrown. This single change also resolves warning SA-4 (ROUTING_SIDECAR_MISSING, lib/plan-routing-sidecar.mjs:286-289, likewise unnamed) and stops revision 5 from enumerating codes a third time and missing a fourth. CWE-1284.
```
